model: MobileFaceNet ArcFace Structured-Pruned (last-4-of-12 blocks, 15% mid-width sparsity)

quality_filter.note: Pairs excluded if either image's FaceQNet quality score is below the bottom-N% cutoff (computed on the full scored LFW population) or if SCRFD detection failed on that image. Filtering applied via the same None-cache-entry mechanism baseline_pipeline.py already uses for undetected faces -- lfw_10fold/compute_fairness_metrics unmodified.

latency.note: Re-measured 2026-09-11 under confirmed-clean conditions (RGB-sync/telemetry apps ASUS Aura Sync + NZXT NGenuity2Helper, GoogleDriveFS, Spotify, Chrome closed; power plan switched to High performance) for a consistent footing with the ResNet-50 FP32/INT8 re-benchmark, which found the original session ran under external system contention. Original figures were median 3.63ms, p95 4.28ms; the corrected p95 (5.31ms) is somewhat higher across the 3 repeats (one repeat saw a transient p95 of 7.02ms) -- likely residual jitter from this small/fast model's short calls rather than the same contention pattern seen in ResNet-50, but reported as measured rather than smoothed further. Methodology: n_warmup=100, n_runs=1000, median of 3 repeats, same as all other variants.

latency_note: Reused from the unfiltered baseline run for this model -- latency is a per-inference model property independent of which pairs are included in the accuracy/fairness stats.
